image_description: A retail display rack filled with various comic books and graphic novels. The rack is white wire-frame, holding multiple rows of periodicals. Visible titles include 'The Walking Dead', 'Spawn', and 'Superman'. The comics are arranged vertically and horizontally, showing cover art with illustrations and typography. A black chair is visible to the right, and other merchandise hangs on the left.

The spines of the comics are mostly facing inward or are too small/resolved to definitively see staple marks from this distance. It is impossible to verify this specific detail without a macro shot of the spine edge.
